Hi, I’m Veera — and welcome to a good Pack.

I’ve been working professionally with dogs since 2006, first as a dog trainer, then from 2008 as a behavior consultant and a veterinary technician. In 2015, I graduated as an animal trainer and a dog massage therapist.

I created this space to help you build a connected relationship with your dog — one rooted in praise, 
understanding, communication, humor and emotional awareness.

Here, we don’t just talk about leash handling or training techniques. We will also talk about us - and how our part plays it's own role in the relationship that we have with our dogs.

This is a safe place where you’re supported, seen, and never judged. Welcome to a Good pack.

With love,
Veera

Extra info:
- born in Finland, living now in Italy
- mom of two amazing kids 
- always thinking maybe one more dog?
- still technically absolutely horrible
- new material every 14 days
- This content is for educational purposes only. Every dog and situation is different.
